top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on interviews with staff and observation of the operation confirms rodent feces present in the classrooms. Rodent feces was seen in vicinity of furniture and children's toys.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information available during the investigation inspection, sufficient evidence was available to support the facility did not have a menu posted.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.
